# Superchat

Superchat is a unified messaging platform that enables businesses to communicate with customers across multiple channels, including WhatsApp, Instagram Direct, Facebook Messenger, Email, and more.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/superchat/.

## Actions

- **Create Contact**: Create a new contact.
- **Create Template Folder**: Create a new template folder in superchat.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a specific webhook by its id.
- **Get Contact**: Retrieve details of a specific contact by its id.
- **Get File**: Retrieve metadata of a specific file.
- **Get User**: Retrieve details of a specific user by their id.
- **List Channels**: List all channels.
- **List Contacts**: List all contacts.
- **List Conversations**: List all conversations.
- **List Custom Attributes**: List all custom contact attributes.
- **List Inboxes**: List all inboxes.
- **List Labels**: List all labels.
- **List Templates**: List all message templates.
- **List Users**: List all users.
- **List Webhooks**: List all webhooks.
- **Update Contact**: Update information for a specific contact in superchat.
- **Update Webhook**: Update the details of a specific webhook.
